title: Possessed Glitch
description: A picture being taken over: horizontal blocks tear sideways, colour channels split, a dim doppelgänger swims behind the image and it flashes to a negative for a frame. Glitches arrive in clusters — calm stretches broken by violent seizures that thicken the tearing and crush the contrast. Tearing, channel split and glitch rate are log sliders; seizures react to beats.
